description.zh: 经典弹球打砖块。鼠标控制底部平台，让小球反弹击碎所有砖块。特殊砖块碎裂后会掉落道具：小球分身、加速、加宽平台、减速与额外生命，逐关挑战更高分！
description.en: Classic brick breaker. Move the paddle with your mouse, bounce the ball and smash every brick. Special bricks drop power-ups: multi-ball, speed up, wide paddle, slow down and extra lives. Clear levels and chase the high score!

controls.zh: 鼠标 / 触摸拖动移动平台，点击 / 空格发球，Esc / P 暂停
controls.en: Mouse / touch drag to move the paddle, click / Space to launch, Esc / P to pause
